correctness.rationale: A domain individual determines complementary positive and negative world footprints. Maximal supporting sets force every F and complement of each G as realized footprints. The pair exists precisely when every F contains a complement of G and vice versa; using F union H realizes both questions, so minimal size is |F union H|. The resulting nonempty interval-convex Boolean-lattice set has minima H and maxima F. The union of two antichains obeys the 2-Sperner maximal-two-level bound, attained by adjacent middle ranks. n=1 boundary gives two footprints for one world. n4 enumeration is genuinely exhaustive over all 65535 nonempty sets of sixteen possible footprints.
